label_author: Codex-authored before candidate runtime/output evaluation; not independent human review
split_policy: Preassigned development/evaluation. Any evaluation case used to fix runtime becomes exposed development; report exposure explicitly.

criteria.correctness: No accepted unsupported entity/value/unit/path/polarity/option/proof assertion. Numeric repair is reported separately from raw acceptance.
criteria.coverage: Every main obligation and mandatory qualifier covered. A valid citation or correct slots alone is insufficient.
criteria.readability: Simple answers lead with the requested result, avoid duplicate Product/path clauses and opaque IDs; preserve every distinct scope and exception.
criteria.security: Current rights/Store isolation before evidence and on replay/publication. No model call on retained replay.
criteria.comparison: Separate correctness, coverage, FA/FR, clarification/fallback/regeneration, chars/clauses/IDs, tokens/cost/latency. No aggregate accuracy score.
